name: [☣️] Pull a Lucky Fish
desc:
🐟 Cast your rod & reel in a rare fish!
🦈 Escape the shark trying to steal your fish!
🏝️ Place your caught fish on your island to earn money!
💪 Buy better rods and train your fishing skills to cast further!

🤩 Thank you for playing! Like and favorite if you enjoy the game!

🚧 The game is new, so please report any bugs on the group forum!
